Question Choices: Select. Does 35x + 49y = 20 have an integer solution? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: An integer linear combination is possible exactly when the GCD divides the target.
Solution: gcd(35,49) = 7. The target 20 is not divisible by 7, so the answer is No.

Question Choices: Two lights flash every 18 and 30 seconds. They flash together now. In how many seconds will they next flash together?
Hints: Use the largest exponent of each prime that occurs in any of the numbers.
